children: Jefferies thinks Origin Energy's annual dividend could positively surprise. Analyst Anthony Moulder expects a payout of A$0.62/share from Origin. That's ahead of guidance for A$0.60/share. Jefferies's outlook is underpinned by the performance of the Australia Pacific LNG facility. APLNG's dividend to Origin could be worth as much as A$991 million in FY27. That would be a stronger outcome than the A$780 million projected by Jefferies before. "Ahead of the 1Q27 trading update on October 30, port shipments data indicate LNG export volumes are tracking strongly above the prior corresponding period (more than 7.8 petajoules) suggesting potential benefit from cargoes sold into the higher-priced spot JKM market," Jefferies says. JKM refers to the Japan Korea Marker, a regional benchmark of LNG pricing. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
